DescriptionUpon his 100th birthday, a locathah king's status is officially acknowledged, and he is honored with the presentation of a special weapon, the war trident, reserved exclusively for the use of his kind. These tridents are ligher than normal and as a result they gain finesse and have a x3 critical hit multiplier. items.name: Devilfish Hide
items.description: This +1 hide armor was made for the Locathath King from the scales of the fearsome devilfish. It provides the wearer with a permanent Slipstream effect.

items.name: Heavy Wooden Shield
items.description: A heavy wooden shield is essentially the same as a heavy steel shield, except that it responds differently to some spells and effects (such as rusting grasp). A druid can use a heavy wooden shield, but not a heavy steel shield.
